senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-का-कं)
A measure of grain equal to four Prasthas, or containing nearly 7 lbs. 11 oz. avoirdupois: in Bengal an Araka is equal to two mans or 164 lbs. avds.
f. (-की)
1 A kind of pulse, (Cytisus cajan.)
2 A fragrant earth: see तुबरी.
E.
आङ, ढोक to go, irregularly अच, fem. ङीप्^1, or टाप with इक inserted.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: missing virAma.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Sown with an ĀḌhaka of seed, (a field, &c.)
2 Holding or containing the same.
E.
आढक the measure, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
See the preceding.
E.
आढक, ख aff.
